children: Realty firm Kalpataru Ltd on Thursday reported a consolidated net loss of ₹70.67 crore for the quarter ended September.
Its net profit stood at ₹4.96 crore in the year-ago period.
Total income fell to ₹479.37 crore in the second quarter of this fiscal from ₹815.66 crore in the corresponding period of the preceding financial year, according to a regulatory filing.
Mumbai-based Kalpataru Ltd is one of the leading real estate developers in the country.

title: Kalpataru Ltd posts ₹71 cr loss in Q2 on lower income
